prompt: Did Zhang Wufeng actually commit a crime?
response: Zhang Wufeng is a fictional character from the novel "The Smiling, Proud Wanderer" (笑傲江湖) by Jin Yong (Louis Cha). In the story, Zhang Wufeng is the head of the Wudang School and is framed for a crime he did not commit. He is accused of betraying his friends and stealing the "Nine Yin Manual," a forbidden martial arts manual. Due to the frame-up, he is forced to flee and eventually commits suicide to avoid the shame and misunderstanding. In the context of the novel, Zhang Wufeng is innocent of the crimes he is accused of, and his story is a tragic one that highlights themes of betrayal and misunderstanding.
